record.question: In apicomplexan parasite, recognition and penetration of a target cell is taken by the following organelles such as _______ & _______, respectively.
record.explanation: The printed page confirms the organelles are requested in recognition-then-penetration order. Micronemes secrete adhesins for host-cell recognition and attachment, while the conoid and its associated machinery participate in penetration, making Microneme, Conoid the best supplied pair. Confidence is medium because the stem generalizes across Apicomplexa, whereas a conoid is not universal and invasion also requires other structures (experimental support: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.ppat.1005388).
